title: Verified skill installation execution
description: Explicit supported-target installation with trusted candidate acquisition, scoped destination preflight, authorized replacement, and accurate plans/results.

operations.name: install_selected_skills
operations.purpose: Plan or perform the requested installation under the current target and replacement contract.
inputs: Explicit supported target and release/source selection, requested mode, and exact installation destination context.
Applicable replacement permission and the package-bundled trusted artifact metadata basis.
outputs: An attributable preliminary dry-run plan, blocked/conflict outcome, or actual scoped installation result including completed units, failures, known effects, and private-safe diagnostics.
behavior: Reject unsupported targets, modes, and removed state-writing options before prohibited acquisition or target effects.
For real installation, acquire the selected trusted candidate under IF-005 and validate integrity, extraction boundaries, and inventory before destination writes.
Preflight every selected destination unit. Without explicit replacement permission, an existing unit is a conflict even if its bytes match; preserve shared parents and unrelated files.
Recheck applicable destination conditions and apply only supported creation or full-unit replacement; force does not bypass integrity, path, symlink, or race protections.

A dry run performs only its declared preliminary checks without downloading, extracting, or changing project files. Real partial failures identify actual completed units and remaining work without promising whole-project rollback.
Do not create managed state, perform an automatic upgrade, or adopt a workflow as a side effect of installing files.

failure_behavior.condition: Metadata, archive, path, target, or destination basis is invalid, unsupported, unsafe, or conflicting.
failure_behavior.outcome: Block dependent effects and identify the applicable safe correction without exposing private inputs.

failure_behavior.condition: An operation fails after some permitted units changed.
failure_behavior.outcome: Report completed units and known remaining/failed scope under the existing partial-failure contract; do not claim a full install or blind retry safety.

consistency_rules: Preflight and mutation scope are the candidate's explicitly selected units, never the shared installation parent or unrelated project content.
Package verification is distinct from destination authorization and from actual installed-byte verification.
The result preserves planned, blocked, partial, and actual effects. Declared dry-run checks never stand in for archive-verified preflight.
compatibility_rules: The existing Installation Design owns exact supported targets, flags, trusted channels, destination units, diagnostic envelopes, and retry rules.
The command consumer must preserve all installation outcomes and cannot broaden force into arbitrary overwrite permission.
This draft introduces no managed upgrade mechanism or new target support.

sources.basis: Allocate the installation command family to MOD-014 while MOD-010 owns public dispatch and output presentation; derive from SRC-PUBLISHED-INSTALLATION and retain its exact safety and compatibility details.
